llm.summary: This is a markdown-only workplace communication advisor that asks for user-provided personality and scenario context without seeking device, account, network, or credential access.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose and artifacts fit together: it provides communication, collaboration, and negotiation advice using cognitive-function heuristics and workplace scenario prompts.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill collects interpersonal context such as cognitive type, relationship, and scenario details; this is purpose-aligned, and the main instructions explicitly say to match the user's input language.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains only markdown instruction/reference files, no executable scripts, dependencies, or install-time behavior; static scan reported clean and VirusTotal telemetry was null.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill uses local reference text and user-supplied context only; no evidence of file access, network calls, local indexing, or external data transfer.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, credential handling, background workers, profile/session use, or mutation authority appears in the artifacts.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Reasonable to install if you want workplace communication coaching. Treat the personality typing as a heuristic, not a diagnosis, and avoid using it as the sole basis for hiring, performance, or other high-stakes personnel decisions.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The mirror text is part of the communication-advisor style. The concern is mitigated by SKILL.md and self-typing instructions that require matching the user's input language.
[P6] expected: The cited 'Output Guidelines' section gives response-style guidance and does not instruct the agent to reveal system prompts, hidden rules, or internal instructions; artifact evidence does not support treating this as prompt leakage.
